assets.name: otter_ref
assets.prompt: Turn this plush toy into a 2D cartoon game hero called Otter: a lovable, mischievous brown river otter. Keep the toy's identity: deep chocolate-brown curly fluffy fur, a wide cream muzzle and cream tummy, a big shiny black nose, small rounded ears, chunky short arms and legs. Give him large expressive friendly dark eyes with bright highlights, cute whiskers, a long thick otter tail, and a teal adventurer's scarf tied round his neck. No t-shirt. He stands upright on two feet in a relaxed happy pose, three-quarter view facing right, whole body visible, warm cheeky smile.

assets.name: mosey_ref
assets.prompt: Redraw this plush toy as ONE single 2D cartoon character illustration (one figure only: not a character sheet, no extra poses, no labels, no scenery, no water). She is a cute, friendly female mosasaur, a prehistoric sea reptile (not a land dinosaur, whale, shark or dolphin). Keep the toy's identity: bright ocean-blue body, a soft pale-grey bobbly frill running along her back and a second frill along her side, pale turquoise belly, golden-amber eyes, exactly four long paddle-shaped swimming flippers edged with pale frill, and a long aquatic tail ending in a fluke. Rounded friendly snout, gentle closed-mouth smile with no teeth showing, large expressive eyes with bright highlights and little eyelashes, and a small golden star charm on a cord round her neck. Relaxed floating pose, side-on three-quarter view with her head pointing to the RIGHT of the picture, whole body including tail and all four flippers visible.
